analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: SWAP is demand-led, so employer vacancies and local sector demand are core indicators of delivery opportunity.
Starts and employment outcomes should be read alongside the programme model: pre-employment training, work experience and a guaranteed interview.
Training-provider and employer partnerships are particularly important because SWAP links skills provision directly to live recruitment demand.
